title: Retraction-Based Gradient Projection Algorithms on Manifolds
summary: We introduce a framework for retraction-based convex optimization on Riemannian manifolds, which includes a notion of retraction-specific convex sets and retraction-based gradient projection algorithms. The standard theory of gradient projection algorithms generalizes easily to this framework. Within this framework, we establish convergence results for retraction-based gradient projection algorithms with various stepsize rules.
